Serena Williams stands center court, arms extended high as she holds the gleaming 2013 China Open trophy above her head. The ornate gold cup features detailed floral engravings and two decorative handles, with a plaque inscribed “Women's Singles Champion.” Her joyful expression and the stadium lights in the background underscore the triumph of her 11–1 record at this event.

This photograph appears in an article ranking Serena Williams’ top five tournaments by win percentage. It highlights her dominant 91% win rate at the China Open, the highest of her career, and situates this victory among her successes at the Australian Open, Wimbledon, US Open, and Miami Open.
